intro: Convert kilometers (km) to miles (mi) with exact precision for road trips, race distances, and international travel planning. Under the international yard and pound definition, 1 statute mile equals exactly 1.609344 kilometers, meaning 1 km equals 0.62137119 miles. Use this km to mi converter for decimals like 3.5 km or 10.5 km, or jump directly to any benchmark in the conversion chart for kilometers to miles below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact 1.609344 Divisor & Statute vs. Nautical Miles
items: The exact conversion between kilometers and statute miles uses 1 mi = 1.609344 km (so 1 km ≈ 0.62137119 mi). Approximating 1 km as 0.6 miles introduces a ~3.4% undercount.
Do not confuse statute miles (1.609344 km, used on roads) with maritime/aviation nautical miles (1 nmi = 1.852 km).

faqs.question: How many miles (mi) are in 1 kilometer (km)?
faqs.answer: There are approximately 0.62137119 statute miles (mi) in 1 kilometer (km), which rounds to 0.6214 mi. Conversely, 1 statute mile equals exactly 1.609344 kilometers.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilometers to miles (km to mi)?
faqs.answer: To convert kilometers to miles, divide the kilometer figure by 1.609344 (or multiply by 0.62137119). For example, 21 km ÷ 1.609344 equals 13.0488 miles.

faqs.question: What is 200 kilometers in miles?
faqs.answer: 200 kilometers (km) equals 124.27424 statute miles (mi), or roughly 124.3 miles on a road trip.
